errors.location: Introduction: paragraph beginning 'Therefore, we propose TSAR-MVS' and contributions 1–3; related-work paragraph mentioning TSAR-MVS; abstract and conclusion
errors.description: The manuscript gives incompatible definitions of its proposed method and misattributes novelty. The introduction proposes TSAR-MVS with filtering, superpixel refinement and edge/line segmentation, while the abstract, ablations and conclusion propose MSP-MVS with segmentation-guided patch deformation, anchor equidistribution and iterative local search. The related-work section also identifies TSAR-MVS as an existing method. These are different algorithmic contributions, so the introduction's claims about the method being introduced contradict the manuscript's own method identification and attribution.
errors.evidence: Introduction: 'we propose TSAR-MVS, a generalized post-processing MVS method that sequentially applies confidence-based outliers filtering, superpixel-based local refinement, and feature-based area generation'. Related work: 'TSAR-MVS (Yuan et al. 2024b) attempt to employ superpixel planarization'. Conclusion: 'we introduce MSP-MVS' and 'we introduce anchor equidistribution' and 'we present ILS optimization'.
